title: Better-than-expected outcomes and expectations
summary: This topic centers on whether the car or specific aspects such as fuel economy met or exceeded expectations, but many fragments are too brief or heterogeneous to support a single clear interpretation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car turned out to be a good purchase or was liked more than expected.

mixed.summary: The mixed review expresses disappointment versus prior expectations, especially around expected BMW reliability.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention expectations, fuel economy, delivery issues, faults, or translation quality, but the sampled excerpts are too fragmentary or varied to summarize as one clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the topic has limited clear sentiment evidence.
